fields.Name: Common: Party Lookup People
fields.UserQuestion: Which people match what the user is typing into a person picker?
fields.Description: Up to 20 people whose last name, display name or email starts with the typed term, or whose email domain starts with the typed domain. Backs bizapps-party-field.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: one row per Person, TOP 20 ordered by DisplayName, ID. Base table __mj_BizAppsCommon.Person, prefix LIKE on indexed LastName, DisplayName, Email and EmailDomain; no view, no COUNT. Parameters: Term (required), Domain (optional, lower-cased, no leading @). Columns: ID, Name, Detail (Email).
